name: Solomon USDv
oneLiner: USDV is Solomon Labs's synthetic dollar on Solana backed by Ceffu-custodied delta-neutral perp margin, with no permissionless public redemption rail.
collateral: Ceffu-custodied strategy assets and off-exchange delta-neutral margin used by Solomon Labs to back USDv
pegMechanism: USDv targets $1 through Solomon-managed strategy collateral, market liquidity, and approved/whitelisted participant redemption into USDC against a small documented protocol reserve buffer; no permissionless public holder redemption rail is disclosed

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Solomon's official launch history says USDv operated through a year-long live beta before its November 2025 public introduction, and describes the yield engine as a spot-long, perpetual-short basis trade across major cryptoassets. The issuer's current site independently describes USDv as operating live since late 2024 across Treasuries and delta-neutral strategies, supporting the synthetic-delta-neutral classification and a conservative Q4 2024 implementation date, stored at its range end (2024-12).

sources.label: Solomon official introduction and year-long beta disclosure

proofOfReserves.provider: Solomon Labs documentation (no published reserve attestation artefact exists; the former asset-attestations docs URL serves an empty shell, and current docs state USDv reserves are USDG and USDC with direct short-dated US Treasury exposure being added — the earlier Ceffu-custodied basis-trade narrative is gone from the docs)

notices.title: Partial reserve coverage
notices.message: USDv has on-chain supply validation and a live issuer protocol-data API, but the API's reported reserve components covered only about 32.9% of protocolTvl at 2026-07-30; the remaining 67.1% is unmapped. Public Ceffu attestations are aggregate, custodian-issued, and stale (latest 2026-04-01). The modeled redemption backstop is limited to approved/whitelisted participants and a documented 0.5% instant reserve buffer; the live feed validates Solana token supply only, while reserve composition is Ceffu-custodied off-exchange and is not on-chain verifiable.
